type AssertNever<T extends never> = T;
type Plain = AssertNever<{ item: number }[never]>;
type NoShared = { a: number } | { b: string };
type Empty = AssertNever<NoShared[keyof NoShared]>;
type Top = AssertNever<unknown[never]>;
type Bottom = AssertNever<never[never]>;
type Str = string[never];
type Arr = number[][never];
type Dict = { [key: string]: boolean }[never];
type Both = { [key: string]: boolean; [key: symbol]: 3 }[never];
type Weak<T> = T[never];
type Mapped<T> = { [P in keyof T]: T[P] }[never];
type WithIndex<T> = Record<string, T>[never];
const s: Str = 's';
const n: Arr = 1;
const b: Dict = true;
const both: Both = 3;
console.log(s,n,b,both);
function emptyValue(x: NoShared, key: never): never { return x[key]; }
function arrayValue(x: number[], key: never): number { return x[key]; }
